fact: Official Gazette General Notice No. 985 of 2025 records the President appointing an eight-member Board of the Seychelles Bureau of Standards for three years from 1 August 2025, under section 5 of the Seychelles Bureau of Standards Act 2014 as last amended by Act 16 of 2021; the notice names no standard.

SeyLII's record of the Seychelles Bureau of Standards Act, 2014 (Act 2 of 2014) shows it repealing the earlier Bureau of Standards Act, commenced 16 June 2014 and amended in 2016 and 2021; only the citation and history page is captured, not the Act's text.

The Seychelles Bureau of Standards Act, 2014 (Act 2 of 2014, assented 28 March 2014, repealing the 1987 Act) establishes the Seychelles Bureau of Standards as a body corporate (s.3) with the function of preparing draft standards and declaring them Seychelles Standards by Gazette notice (s.4(b), s.14); the Act commences on a date the Minister appoints by Gazette notice, which this text does not give.
